entries.text: As per 而# (soft and droopy) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → be drenched and become soft and droopy. *Demand* and *require* are borrowed meanings.
𩓣也。遇雨不進，止𩓣也。从雨而聲。《易》曰：“雲上於天，需。”
霢霂也。从雨沐聲。
久陰也。从雨沈聲。
雨䨘爲霄。从雨肖聲。齊語也。
霅霅，震電皃。一曰眾言也。从雨，譶省聲。
As per 廷# (extend) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → (a long bolt of) *lightning* → (a long clap of) *thunder*.
雷餘聲也鈴鈴。所以挺出萬物。从雨廷聲。

As per 辰# (twitch) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → thunder(ous vibrations) in the natural world → *thunder*; *shake*; *tremble*; *vibrate*; *quiver*; *shiver* → *wield* (power); *use violence* → *display* (one's talent) (← wield) → *obtain good results*.
劈歴，振物者。从雨辰聲。《春秋傳》曰：“震夷伯之廟。”
As per 沛# (abundant water) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → *torrential rain*.
霽謂之霋。从雨妻聲。

靃 combines 隹 short, squat bird (doubled) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → (the sound of) birds hurriedly taking flight in a sudden rainstorm → *quick*; (disappear) *suddenly*. 靃 has been supplanted by 霍, which eliminates one of the 隹 elements.
As per 妾# (close proximity) + 雨 rain/natural phenomenon → *passing shower*; *short while* (← natural phenomenon that is close but passing/fleeting).
小雨也。从雨妾聲。
非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → driving *rain/snow*.
雨雲皃。从雨非聲。
沾# soak; moisten + 雨 rain/natural phenomenon → *soak*/*moisten* (in rainwater; compare 霪).
雨𩃵也。从雨沾聲。
兒# infant(ile) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → *rainbow*, associated with a goddess regarded as having created mankind. For "rainbow," compare 虹.
屈虹，青赤，或白色，陰气也。从雨兒聲。
林# forest + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → *long spell of rain* (originally, with specific reference to rain in a forest).
雨三日已往。从雨林聲。
英# brilliance + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → blinding *sleet*, likened to blinding brilliance.
地气發，天不應。从雨敄聲。
相# mutual + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → pillars of *frost*, facing each other.
喪也。成物者。从雨相聲。
雨 rain/natural phenomena + 囗 (here a shape indicator suggesting linked beads of water; compare 露, 落 and 零) tripled → linked *raindrops* → *drops of liquid*; *falling in drops*.
雨零也。从雨，𠱠象𩂣形。《詩》曰：“霝雨其濛。”
As per 叚# (overlay) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → *reddish clouds* or *haze* that overlays the sky → *dim*; *blurred*.
赤雲气也。从雨叚聲。
霢霂，小雨也。从雨脈聲。
雨也。齊人謂靁爲霣。从雨員聲。一曰雲轉起也。
As per 留# (round) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → round *raindrops*/*dripping water* (that collects).
As per 務# (exertion) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → vigorous, fine *spray* from a geyser → *fog*; *mist*.
雨止雲罷皃。从雨郭聲。
As per 淫# (heavy indulgence → heavy) + 雨 rain/natural phenomenon → *protracted, heavy rain*. Compare 霑.
散# scatter + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → sleet or *hail* (that scatters through the sky; compare 雹) → *small cubes*.

路# + 雨 rain/natural phenomena. A variant of 落 *dew* → *open*; *exposed* (← see through a transparent object). Also, *transience of life* (← dew as a quickly dissipating element). *Russia* is via the phonetic construction 露西亜 (露西亞).
潤澤也。从雨路聲。
月始生，霸然也。承大月，二日；承小月，三日。从月䨣聲。《周書》曰：“哉生霸。”
As per 辟# (spread) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → *thunder* spreading over the sky.
齊# uniform + 雨 rain/natural phenomenon → sky made uniform by the end of rain/snowfall → *clear up*.
雨止也。从雨齊聲。
As per 貍# the original form of 狸 (shelter) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → *dust storm* necessitating the taking of shelter.
風雨土也。从雨貍聲。《詩》曰：“終風且霾。”
天气下，地不應，曰霿。霿，晦也。从雨瞀聲。
陰陽薄動靁雨，生物者也。从雨，畾象回轉形。
As per 歷# (neat lines) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → neat string of thunderbolts → *thunder*.
飛聲也。雨而雙飛者，其聲靃然。
As per 謁# (cut off) + 雨 rain/natural phenomena → cloudy sky or *haze*, cutting off vision (compare 曖 and 靉) → *mist*; *fog*.
雲皃。从雨，藹省聲。
逮# chase + 雲 cloud → clouds metaphorically chasing other clouds in dark skies → *thick, rolling clouds*.
As per 霝# (linked) + 巫 sorcery → medium invoking a procession of spirits → *spirit*; *soul*.

As per 愛# (hinder) + 雲 cloud → cloudy sky, hindering the penetration of sunlight (compare 靄 and 曖) → *motionless clouds*. Also, *dark* and *obscure*. The compound 靉靆 indicates heavy clouds (and mist).

The relevant bronzeware inscription form combines 生# (fresh grass shoots) + 井/丼 (pure well water) → grass that is fresh, clean and pure → *green*; *blue* → *youth*; *immaturity*. In dual-element characters, 青 may also appear in the form 靑.
東方色也。木生火，从生、丹。丹青之信言象然。凡青之屬皆从青。
青 here an abbreviated form# of 靜 calm/peaceful + 立 stand → stand still/at ease → *tranquil*; *at ease*; *peaceful*.
立竫也。从立青聲。一曰細皃。
As per 靑/青# (clean/pure) + 見 (affix one's sight on) → *adorn* oneself to appear beautiful (← clean/pure) to others → (put on) *makeup*; *ornament oneself*.
召也。从見青聲。
爭 struggle + 靑/青# (clean/pure) → *bring peace*; *calm*; *quiet*; *soothe*; *appease*; *quell*; *still*; *standstill*; *peaceful* (← calm a struggle).
審也。从青爭聲。

A depiction of curved wings that spread in alignment to right and left → *not*; *non-*; *in-*; *un-* (← brush off a request in objecting/refusing → *object*; *refuse*) → *fault*; *mistake*; *wrong*; *incorrect* (← negativity). Compare 不, as well as 拂.
違也。从飛下翄，取其相背。凡非之屬皆从非。
As per 告# (bend) + 非 (spread in alignment to right and left) → *lean on*, forcing someone/something to bend → *depend on*.
相違也。从非告聲。

As per 麻# (rub and scrape) + 非 (spread in alignment to right and left) → *scatter* objects to right and left in the process of rubbing/scraping → *wave/flutter* (← move back and forth between right and left). Also, *yield to* (← waver).
披靡也。从非麻聲。

The relevant seal inscription form combines 首 neck/head + a line# adhering to and nearly surrounding it, suggesting a *mask* adhering closely to and partially obscuring the *face* → *surface*; *aspect* → *turn (a face) to*; *look away*; *side*; *direction* → *counter* (for flat objects).
顔前也。从𦣻，象人面形。凡面之屬皆从面。

麵.explanation: The traditional noodle/flour form is 麵 in Taiwan standard writing (e.g. 麵條); the face/surface sense remains 面. 麪條 is a variant form seen in OpenCC's basic conversion.
麵.example: 面条 → 麵條 (Taiwan writing uses 麵; 麪條 is a variant form seen in OpenCC's basic conversion); 面子 → 面子
麵.evidenceScope: All examples in this note were individually reviewed against cited pinned OpenCC phrase records or identified supplementary sources. This does not establish unconditional character conversion, all regional spelling choices or full mainland-2013 certification.
麵.usageCaveat: Specify the regional orthography rather than attributing 麵條 directly to the OpenCC base STPhrases record.

lexicalEvidence.methodology: Exact version-pinned phrase records, with independently identified dictionary, composed-example or literary evidence where needed; no native OpenCC execution was performed.

supplementarySources.finding: Headword 麵條 denotes noodles made from flour.

attestedTargets.qualification: 麵條 is a Taiwan MOE headword; the base OpenCC phrase row uses 麪條 and TWVariants records 麪→麵.

qualification.recommendation: Label 麵條 as Taiwan-supported spelling or cite Taiwan MOE directly. If citing base STPhrases, accurately report 麪條 and the separate TWVariants 麪→麵 record.

entries.text: As per 面# (adhere) + 見 see → *impudent* (← brazenly regard another person's visage); *feel ashamed* (← be self-conscious about being stared at).
面見也。从面、見，見亦聲。《詩》曰：“有靦面目。”
As per 厭# (press upon) + 面 face → *dimple(s)*. Compare 黶.
姿也。从面厭聲。
A depiction of a tautly stretched animal hide, one being made into *leather* → *make taut*. Also, *reform* (← renew an object by stretching it tautly).
獸皮治去其毛，革更之。象古文革之形。凡革之屬皆从革。
補履下也。从革丁聲。
As per 叉# (forked) + 革 leather → leather saddle or *quiver* that forks in being placed over a horse's back.
靬，乾革也。武威有麗靬縣。从革干聲。
馬羈也。从革勺聲。
刃 here an abbreviated form# of 忍 endure + 革 leather → *pliable* *leather*, able to endure great tension → *soft* (and strong) (← pliable). Also, *quiver* (made of soft leather). 靭 is a variant form.
鞮也。从革今聲。
As per 斤# (adhere) + 革 leather → *leather strap* adhering to a horse (stretching from breast to saddle, or binding the midsection; compare 鞅).
當膺也。从革斤聲。
化# + 革 leather. 靴 was devised to transliterate a word used by one northern Chinese tribe that referred to leather riding boots → *footwear*; *shoe*.
巴# (spread) + 革 leather → leather spread for use in the form of a *target* or a *bridle*.
轡革也。从革巴聲。
引# pull/draw + 革 leather → *leather cords* by which a beast of burden pulls a vehicle.
引軸也。从革引聲。
小兒履也。从革及聲。讀若沓。
柔革也。从革，从旦聲。

As per 召# (curve) + 革 leather → *musical instrument* with a small, drum-like attachment at the end of a handle. When swung, a ball at the end of a cord curves in an arc and strikes the leather skin of the "drum," producing sound. Compare 鼗.
鞀遼也。从革召聲。
As per 皮# (align) + 革 leather → leather, *equestrian harness* with aligned *reins*.
車駕具也。从革皮聲。
車軾也。从革弘聲。《詩》曰：“鞹鞃淺幭。”讀若穹。
包# envelop + 革 leather → leather *bag* in which objects are wrapped → *suitcase*; *briefcase*.
柔革工也。从革包聲。讀若朴。《周禮》曰：“柔皮之工鮑氏。”鞄卽鮑也。
As per 央# (stretch) + 革 leather → *leather strap* (stretching from a horse's breast to its saddle, or binding its midsection) → *be pressured*.
頸靼也。从革央聲。
防汗也。从革合聲。
As per 圭# (cone-shaped) + 革 leather → (cone-shaped, pointy) *footwear*.
馬鞁具也。从革从安。
As per 安# (rest in/on) + 革 leather → *saddle* (upon which the rider's buttocks rest).
車革前曰鞎。从革艮聲。
As per 巩# as described in 恐 (fasten) + 革 leather → fasten with a piece of leather → *bind tightly* → *tight*; *hard*; *firm*.
以韋束也。《易》曰：“鞏用黃牛之革。”从革巩聲。
革 leather + 上 above + 下 below → *clamp* or *clasp* that binds two strips of leather (← clamp from both above and below).
履空也。从革免聲。
As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 革 leather → small strip of leather (compare 鞦). *Sheath*, *scabbard* and *margin/commission* are borrowed meanings.
刀室也。从革肖聲。
大車縛軛靼。从革肙聲。
As per 空# (connecting pipe → connect) + 革 leather → leather reins and bridle connecting horse and rider → *bit* (← apparatus connected to a bridle ).
沓# pile + 革 leather → *leather shoes* (with layers of leather).
卑# low + 革 leather → leather *sheath*, worn low. *Drum* carried on horseback is a borrowed meaning via 鼙.
刀室也。从革卑聲。
As per 匊# (wrap about) + 革 leather → tightly wrapped leather *ball* (compare 毬). Also, *quiz/grill* (in investigating) (← tighten the pressure on a suspect; compare 絞 and 訊).
蹋鞠也。从革匊聲。
柔# soft + 革 leather → soften a hide/leather in tanning it → *tan*; *tanned leather*. Compare 靱.
耎也。从革从柔，柔亦聲。
轡鞥。从革弇聲。讀若譍。一曰龍頭繞者。
As per 秋# (shrunken) + 革 leather → shrunken piece of leather (compare 鞘) → *leather strap* (wound about the tail of a beast of burden).

鞦.explanation: 鞦 is used in the traditional spelling 鞦韆 (swing); 秋 meaning autumn remains 秋.
鞦.example: 秋千 → 鞦韆; 秋天 → 秋天
鞦.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: As per 曷# (cut off) + 革 leather → cut pieces of dried leather to make *footwear*.
車軸束也。从革敄聲。
An abbreviated form# of 鞠 quiz/grill in investigating + 言 words (for emphasis/clarification) → *grill a suspect/criminal*; *interrogate*; *investigate*.
建# erect + 革 leather → leather *quiver* placed upright on a horse.
所以戢弓矢。从革建聲。
As per 便# (cause to spread) + 革 leather → wield a *whip* → *encourage* (← whip on).
驅也。从革𠊳聲。
As per 是# (straight) + 革 leather → long, flat strip of leather → *leather footwear* (crafted from such strips).
革履也。从革是聲。
荅# (press/fit together) + 革 leather → a multi-skinned drum. The compound 鞺鞳 refers to the sound produced by a beaten drum.

As per the right-hand element# as described in 備 (arrows spread through a quiver) + 革 leather → leather quiver (compare 箙) → saddle (← different kind of leather product spread over a back, in this case a horse's). *Bellows* is a borrowed meaning.
革生鞮也。从革奚聲。
As per 般# (spread out) + 革 leather → *broad leather belt/waistband*; (horse's saddle) *girth*.
大帶也。《易》曰：“或錫之鞶帶。”男子帶鞶，婦人帶絲。从革般聲。
郭# enclosure + 革 leather → *leather* or *skin* (that encloses a body or wrapped object).
去毛皮也。《論語》曰：“虎豹之鞹。”从革郭聲。
堂# (stretch) + 革 leather → hide stretched over a large drum → *the sound of a drum*.
韋繡也。从革貴聲。
鞮屬。从革華聲。
As per 畺# (tight; taut) + 革 leather → leather drawn tautly against a horse or beast of burden → *reins*; *bridle*.
佩刀絲也。从革蒦聲。

韆.explanation: 韆 is the differentiated final character in the traditional word for a swing, 鞦韆; 千 meaning one thousand remains 千.
韆.example: 秋千 → 鞦韆; 一千 → 一千
韆.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: 弓矢韇也。从革𧷏聲。
As per 蔑# (obscure) + 革 leather → *leather undergarment* (obscure on account of being hidden by clothes; compare 襪). *Socks* is a borrowed meaning, via 襪.
馬鞁具也。从革薦聲。
Originally, as per 闌# (link) + 革 leather → two or more pieces of leather joined to create a *case for a bow and arrows*. The present form replaces 闌 with 蘭.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character combines 囗# circular enclosure with a pair of crossing feet → go around/*circumambulate* or *patrol* an enclosure. (Tanned) *leather* is a borrowed meaning.
相背也。从舛囗聲。獸皮之韋，可以束枉戾相韋背，故借以爲皮韋。凡韋之屬皆从韋。
Abbreviated form# of 忍 endure + 韋 leather → *pliable* *leather*, able to endure great tension → *soft* (and strong) (← pliable). Also, *quiver* (made of soft leather). Compare 靱.
柔而固也。从韋刃聲。
As per 犮# (split away) + 韋 leather → *leather kneepad* separate (= split away) from one's outfit (compare 韠). *Braided, ornamented cord identifying one's rank* is a borrowed meaning via 紱.
As per 末# (minute) + 韋 leather → small piece of tanned leather dyed *red* with dye from the madder plant (茜).
茅蒐𣑱韋也。一入曰韎。从韋末聲。
革中辨謂之韏。从韋𢍏聲。

An abbreviated form# of 幹 (rise high) + 韋 circumambulate → *fence* that rises high in surrounding and blocking off a well. *Korea* and *name of a particular country in ancient China* are borrowed meanings.
長# long + 韋 tanned leather → long leather *sack in which to carry a bow*.
弓衣也。从韋長聲。《詩》曰：“交韔二弓。”
射決也。所以拘弦，以象骨，韋系，著右巨指。从韋枼聲。《詩》曰：“童子佩韘。”
As per 韋# (go around) + 是 straight → go around doing things (= behaving) in the *right* manner → *correct*; *proper*.
是也。从是韋聲。《春秋傳》曰：“犯五不韙。”
舀# dip + 韋 leather → thrust a sword, bow or other weapon into its leather *sheath* or *scabbard* (← thrusting likened to a dipping motion) → *conceal* → *wrap*.
劒衣也。从韋舀聲。
射臂決也。从韋冓聲。
As per 𥁕# as described in 温 (hold in/down) + 韋 leather → items concealed by being held down/wrapped in leather → *wrap*; *conceal*; *hide*.
As per 畢# (split away) + 韋 leather → tanned leather *kneepad* (split/separate from one's clothing).
韍也。所以蔽前，以韋。下廣二尺，上廣一尺，其頸五寸。一命縕韠，再命赤韠。从韋畢聲。
櫜紐也。从韋惠聲。一曰盛虜頭橐也。
弓衣也。从韋蜀聲。
足衣也。从韋蔑聲。
A depiction of a *leek*, the top of which bends back toward the ground. When used as an independent character in Japanese, the variant form 韮, adding 艸 grass/plant, is more common.
菜名。一穜而久者，故謂之韭。象形，在一之上。一，地也。此與耑同意。凡韭之屬皆从韭。

The element minus 韭 combines 从, a variant form of 從 (people in close formation) + 戈 spear/halberd → use the tip of a long, slender weapon in prodding a line of captives to keep moving. To this element# (long and slender), 韱 adds 韭 leek → tall and slender/fine *leek* or *wild scallion* (compare 葱).
山韭也。从韭㦰聲。

The relevant seal inscription form shows 言# words + a line in the mouth element at the bottom → *indistinct utterance* contained in (not emanating as speech from) the mouth (compare 吟) → *sound*; *noise*; *tone* → *news/word of*; *ON reading* of a Han/Chinese character (← read a character by its Sino-Japanese sound; the contrast is to 訓, where the idea is to grasp the signification of a character).
聲也。生於心，有節於外，謂之音。宮商角徵羽，聲；絲竹金石匏土革木，音也。从言含一。凡音之屬皆从音。

召 here an abbreviated form# of 昭 brightness + 音 sound → bright, clear notes of music → beautiful sound → *beautiful*. Also, an ancient type of music said to have been created by a legendary Chinese emperor, 舜.
虞舜樂也。《書》曰：“《簫韶》九成，鳳皇來儀。”从音召聲。
員# round (→ perfectly round → harmonious) + 音 sound → *rhyme*; *meter*; *tone* (← rounded/harmonized sound).
和也。从音員聲。裴光遠云：古與均同。未知其審。
下徹聲。从音酓聲。
鄕 here a variant form of 卿# (be positioned at opposite sides) + 音 sound → transmission of *sound* through space from point of origin to point of reception → *resonance*; *reverberation*.
聲也。从音鄉聲。
